caption: The drawing features a single wooden armchair depicted from the front, centered on a plain, off-white background. The chair has a curved backrest that extends into short armrests on each side. The backrest is supported by several vertical spindles, with the two outermost spindles being slightly thicker than the others. The chair’s seat is wide and rounded, and the front legs are turned with decorative detailing, while the back legs are straighter and angled outward. There are horizontal support bars between the legs, including a turned stretcher connecting the front legs and straight stretchers on the sides. The wood of the chair is a dark brown color with lighter highlights for shading and dimensionality. The composition is centered and symmetrical, with the chair occupying the main portion of the drawing. Surrounding the image is a faint rectangular border, and there are handwritten notations at the bottom reading "Arm Chair," "Scale 1'' = 6''," and "By Clyde L. Cheney."
title: Armchair
